result.instructions: Tools for Balena, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our devices are offline right now, and in which application?"; "Show the CPU, memory and storage of device 1a2b3c."; "What release is the staging fleet running, and which release has commit 4f9e2a1?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Balena data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run balena_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run balena_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run balena_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. balena_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: balena_get_current_user
tools.title: Get the account of the API key
tools.description: Return the Balena user that the configured API key belongs to. Use it to confirm which account the tools act for. Balena API: GET /user/v1/whoami.

annotations.title: Get the account of the API key

tools.name: balena_list_applications
tools.title: List applications
tools.description: List the applications (fleets) the key can access, optionally only those in one organization (by handle). Each row has id, app_name, slug and the device type. Returns { d: [...] }. Balena API: GET /v7/application.

organization.description: Organization handle to filter by, for example acme.

tools.name: balena_get_application
tools.title: Get an application
tools.description: Get one application by numeric id or by slug (org/app), with the devices it owns (expanded). Balena API: GET /v7/application(<id>) or GET /v7/application?$filter=slug eq '<slug>'.

application.description: Application id (number) or slug in org/app form, for example acme/my-app.

tools.name: balena_list_devices
tools.title: List devices
tools.description: List devices, optionally only those in one application and/or only online or offline devices. Returns id, uuid, device_name, is_online, overall_status, status, last_connectivity_event and version fields. Balena API: GET /v7/device.

application.description: Application id or slug to list devices for.

online.description: true = only online devices, false = only offline devices.

tools.name: balena_get_device
tools.title: Get a device
tools.description: Get one device by uuid or numeric id, with its application expanded. Balena API: GET /v7/device(uuid='<uuid>')?$expand=belongs_to__application or GET /v7/device(<id>).

id.description: Numeric device id, if no uuid is given.

tools.name: balena_get_device_health
tools.title: Get device health
tools.description: Get one device's online state, overall_status, last connectivity event, CPU, memory and storage figures. Balena API: GET /v7/device(uuid='<uuid>')?$select=....

id.description: Numeric device id, if no uuid is given.

tools.name: balena_list_releases
tools.title: List releases
tools.description: List the releases (builds) of one application, optionally only the release with one commit hash. Returns id, commit, raw_version, status and is_invalidated. Balena API: GET /v7/release.

application.description: Application id (number) or slug in org/app form, for example acme/my-app.

commit.description: Only the release with this commit hash.

tools.name: balena_get_release
tools.title: Get a release
tools.description: Get one release by its numeric id. Balena API: GET /v7/release(<id>).

tools.name: balena_rename_device
tools.title: Rename a device
tools.description: Set the display name of one device. It changes only the name; it does not touch the running software. Balena API: PATCH /v7/device(uuid='<uuid>') with { device_name }.

tools.name: balena_add_device_note
tools.title: Set a device note
tools.description: Replace the free-text note on one device, for example an owner or a location reminder. It does not touch the running software. Balena API: PATCH /v7/device(uuid='<uuid>') with { note }.

note.description: The new note text (replaces the old note).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Balena
prompts.description: What you can do with Balena here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_offline_devices
prompts.title: Find offline devices
prompts.description: The AI lists the devices of an application that are offline, with their last connectivity event. You see which devices need attention.

prompts.name: check_a_device_s_health
prompts.title: Check a device's health
prompts.description: The AI reads one device's online state, overall status, CPU, memory and storage figures.

prompts.name: find_the_release_of_a_commit
prompts.title: Find the release of a commit
prompts.description: The AI finds the release built from one git commit in an application and shows its status.

prompts.name: rename_or_annotate_a_device
prompts.title: Rename or annotate a device
prompts.description: The AI changes a device's display name or its note. It does not change the running software.
